en.summary: Instruction-TLB insert requests were tagged with the ASID of the next thread selected for fetch rather than the thread that executed the TLB maintenance instruction, so entries could be installed under the wrong address space.
why_it_counts: The patch changes TLB maintenance plumbing in core RTL.
The commit message describes a concrete ASID mix-up during ITLB insertion.
The fix adds an explicit path that carries the issuing thread's ASID into the ITLB update request.
evidence: The patch adds dt_itlb_update_asid in hardware/core/core.sv and hardware/core/dcache_tag_stage.sv and consumes it in hardware/core/ifetch_tag_stage.sv.
dcache_tag_stage now drives dt_itlb_update_asid from cr_current_asid[of_thread_idx], which is the thread executing the maintenance operation.
ifetch_tag_stage changes request_asid from always using cr_current_asid[selected_thread_idx] to using dt_itlb_update_asid on non-fetch ITLB requests.
The commit message states that the old code used the next thread to be fetched.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is a context-tagging error in TLB maintenance. When software inserts or updates an instruction-side TLB entry, the inserted translation must be associated with the address-space identifier of the thread or process that issued the operation. The broken behavior instead borrows ASID context from the fetch arbiter's currently selected thread, so the inserted mapping may be attributed to the wrong address space.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A multithreaded core performs an ITLB insert or update for a thread that is not the same thread currently winning fetch arbitration.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Source the ASID or address-space tag for a TLB maintenance request from the fetch-selected thread rather than the thread that issued the maintenance instruction.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reuse arbiter-selected context for maintenance request metadata
portability_notes: This applies to any design where TLB maintenance is issued on one path and serviced in another pipeline stage or unit.
If the design uses process IDs, VMIDs, or security contexts instead of ASIDs, map the mutation to that equivalent context tag.
The bug is most visible when maintenance and fetch are decoupled across threads or contexts.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the request fields used when an instruction-side TLB insert or update is forwarded into the TLB structure.
Replace the maintenance operation's own context tag with the currently selected fetch or arbitration context tag.
Keep the virtual-page and physical-page data unchanged so the observable fault is wrong ownership of the mapping rather than a malformed entry.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: dt_itlb_update_asid plumbing from dcache_tag_stage to ifetch_tag_stage
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix introduces dt_itlb_update_asid, drives it from cr_current_asid[of_thread_idx], and uses it for non-fetch ITLB request_asid selection in ifetch_tag_stage.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the dedicated dt_itlb_update_asid path and restore request_asid so it always comes from cr_current_asid[selected_thread_idx] even for maintenance requests.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: ITLB entries can be installed under the wrong ASID, leading to cross-thread translation misses, stale mappings, or execution from an incorrect instruction address space.
evidence_for_injection: Before the fix, ifetch_tag_stage always used cr_current_asid[selected_thread_idx] as request_asid.
The fix carries of_thread_idx-derived ASID through a new signal specifically for ITLB update traffic.
The commit message explicitly identifies the wrong-thread ASID source.
notes: This bug shape is highly reusable across designs with decoupled TLB maintenance paths.
If the DUT is single-threaded but supports multiple address spaces, the same mutation can be mapped to using the wrong process context source during maintenance.

zh.summary: 指令 TLB 插入请求原先使用的是下一个被选中取指线程的 ASID，而不是执行 TLB 维护指令的线程 ASID，因此表项可能被装入错误的地址空间。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是核心 RTL 中的 TLB 维护连线。
提交信息描述了 ITLB 插入期间明确的 ASID 混淆错误。
修复新增了一条显式路径，把发出维护操作的线程 ASID 送到 ITLB 更新请求中。
evidence: 补丁在 hardware/core/core.sv 和 hardware/core/dcache_tag_stage.sv 中新增 dt_itlb_update_asid，并在 hardware/core/ifetch_tag_stage.sv 中消费该信号。
dcache_tag_stage 现在从 cr_current_asid[of_thread_idx] 驱动 dt_itlb_update_asid，其中 of_thread_idx 对应执行维护操作的线程。
ifetch_tag_stage 把 request_asid 从总是使用 cr_current_asid[selected_thread_idx] 改成了在非取指 ITLB 请求时使用 dt_itlb_update_asid。
提交信息说明旧代码使用的是“下一个将被取指的线程”。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该错误属于 TLB 维护中的上下文标签错误。当软件插入或更新指令侧 TLB 表项时，该翻译项必须与发出该操作的线程或进程的地址空间标识关联。错误实现却从取指仲裁器当前选中的线程借用了 ASID 上下文，因此插入的映射可能被错误地归属到另一个地址空间。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 指令侧 TLB 维护的上下文标签绑定
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 多线程核心为某线程执行 ITLB 插入或更新，而该线程并不是当前取指仲裁的获胜线程。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 TLB 维护请求的 ASID 或地址空间标签来自当前取指选中线程，而不是发出维护指令的线程。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 复用仲裁选中上下文作为维护请求元数据
portability_notes: 该模式适用于任何“TLB 维护在一个路径发出、在另一个流水级或单元执行”的设计。
如果设计使用的是进程 ID、VMID 或安全上下文而不是 ASID，应把变异映射到等价的上下文标签。
当维护操作与取指在线程或上下文上解耦时，该错误最容易暴露。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到指令侧 TLB 插入或更新被送入 TLB 结构时所使用的请求字段。
把维护操作自身的上下文标签替换成当前取指或仲裁选中的上下文标签。
保持虚拟页和物理页数据不变，使可见故障表现为映射归属错误，而不是表项格式损坏。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 从 dcache_tag_stage 到 ifetch_tag_stage 的 dt_itlb_update_asid 连线
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复引入 dt_itlb_update_asid，使用 cr_current_asid[of_thread_idx] 驱动，并在 ifetch_tag_stage 的非取指 ITLB request_asid 选择中使用该信号。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除专用的 dt_itlb_update_asid 路径，并把 request_asid 恢复成即使在维护请求下也始终来自 cr_current_asid[selected_thread_idx]。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: ITLB 表项会带着错误的 ASID 被装入，导致线程间翻译 miss、陈旧映射命中，或从错误的指令地址空间执行。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前，ifetch_tag_stage 总是使用 cr_current_asid[selected_thread_idx] 作为 request_asid。
修复新增了一条专门面向 ITLB 更新流量的信号，把源自 of_thread_idx 的 ASID 传到消费端。
提交信息明确指出了 ASID 来自错误线程。
notes: 这种错误形态对具有解耦 TLB 维护路径的设计很有可移植性。
如果 DUT 是单线程但支持多个地址空间，也可以把同类变异映射为维护操作期间使用错误的进程上下文源。
